name: Render
tagline: Render is a cloud platform for deploying web apps, APIs, background workers, and databases with automatic scaling and zero-downtime deploys. Developers use it as a Heroku alternative that handles infrastructure so teams can deploy from a Git push without managing servers. It supports Docker containers, static sites, and managed Postgres and Redis instances.
